visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a pair of hands using a large wooden spoon to mix finely chopped green chives into a mound of ground meat inside a large stainless steel bowl. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant green of the herbs against the pinkish meat. (2) The scene cuts to a closer perspective where the hands hold a circular white dumpling wrapper, stretching it slightly with the fingers. A spoon is then used to place a portion of the green chive and meat filling onto the center of the dough. The skin of the hands is clear, and the background remains out of focus, emphasizing the delicate movements. (3) The individual proceeds to dip a finger into a small blue-and-white patterned bowl containing water, tracing a semi-circle along the edge of the wrapper. The hands then begin to pleat and pinch the edges of the dough together, folding it in half and meticulously sealing the filling inside to create a curved, plump dumpling shape. (4) A transition shows a wooden rectangular tray filled with two neat rows of identically wrapped dumplings, their white skins contrasting with the natural wood grain of the board. The camera pans slightly across the tray to display the uniform craftsmanship. (5) The shot shifts to a black frying pan where several dumplings are arranged in a row. A white liquid slurry is poured from a measuring cup into the hot pan, creating a layer around the base of the dumplings. A glass lid with a dark handle is then placed over the pan to trap the steam. (6) The final phase shows the pan being flipped onto a white plate, revealing a perfectly golden-brown and crispy 'ice flower' lattice connecting the dumplings. A pair of dark wooden chopsticks breaks into the crispy crust, lifting a dumpling to show the juicy interior filled with shrimp and chives. The background shows a modern kitchen with pink cabinetry.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: Hello 大家好 我是塔塔. (2) [Subtitle]: 先來示範包餃子的一種方式. (3) [Subtitle]: 把餃子皮撐開來. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後放在掌心. (5) [Subtitle]: 把料放在中間. (6) [Subtitle]: 餃子皮的邊緣沾上半圈的水. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後像這樣拉過來. (8) [Subtitle]: 跟對面黏合. (9) [Subtitle]: 中間的部分先黏合. (10) [Subtitle]: 這樣就會比較好抓中心線. (11) [Subtitle]: 兩手的手指像這樣捏一下. (12) [Subtitle]: 大概是這樣的手勢. (13) [Subtitle]: 然後把餃子的肚子挺出來. (14) [Subtitle]: 用力的捏合. (15) [Subtitle]: 避免爆開. (16) [Subtitle]: 凸凸的肚子. (17) [Subtitle]: 一個水餃就包好了. (18) [Subtitle]: （完整的影片請看留言處）. (19) [Subtitle]: 接著來示範煎餃的包法. (20) [Subtitle]: 餃子的外觀就看個人喜好來捏. (21) [Subtitle]: 沒有一定. (22) [Subtitle]: 這款餃子不管是水餃還是煎餃. (23) [Subtitle]: 都非常好吃喔. (24) [Subtitle]: 水大概加到這個位置就可以了. (25) [Subtitle]: 不用太多. (26) [Subtitle]: 接著趕緊蓋上鍋蓋. (27) [Subtitle]: 讓餃子悶蒸一下. (28) [Subtitle]: 中火大概煎 4 分鐘左右. (29) [Subtitle]: 接著直接倒扣到盤子上. (30) [Subtitle]: 就可以把美美的煎餃屁股朝上了. (31) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，簡單的韭菜蝦仁煎餃. (32) [Subtitle]: 就完成了. (33) [Subtitle]: 嗯，這個煎餃邊緣脆脆的冰花. (34) [Subtitle]: 實在太誘人了. (35) [Subtitle]: 還有蝦仁的鮮味. (36) [Subtitle]: 鮮甜的三星蔥跟韭菜. (37) [Subtitle]: 一咬下去在嘴裡整個爆汁開來. (38) [Subtitle]: 喜歡吃煎餃的朋友趕快動手試試看喔.
